claims.quote: Schistura alticrista is a nemacheilid loach from the Nam Mae Yuan basin in Mae Hong Son Province, northwest Thailand, part of the Salween drainage.
Described from the Nam Mae Yuan river basin in Mae Hong Son Province, north west Thailand, a tributary within the Salween drainage.
It's also been recorded from the Salween itself, close to the point where the Nam Mae Yuan empties into it, and may therefore range into Myanmar to an extent.
